feedback: Judged before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. The evidence is the iteration-4 race (score 483.7, best so far): oval finished 20 of 20 runs (mean 1.99 s, progress 0.997), s-bend finished 3 of 20 (progress 0.71, steering_oscillation 0.41, the highest so far), and slalom finished 0 of 20 (progress 0.32, off track in every run). The weak spot is fast alternating bends, which is consistent with slow response rather than an integral or bias problem. The candidate changes only controller.kp (4.0 to 4.5) and controller.kd (0.6 to 0.8). Geometry, ki 0.5, base_speed 1.3, sensor weights and line_loss are unchanged, so the effect can be read directly. Iteration 3 showed that kp 5 with kd 0.3 overshot, which is why kd rises with kp here. The risk is oval: iteration 4 has steering_oscillation 0.23 there, and a higher kp could push it up and cost the 20/20 completions. The change is small, tied to the slalom evidence, and the candidate is valid. Approve so the race gives per-track telemetry, since a revision would cost two action runs and iterations remain for further tuning. Interpreting the next race: if oval stays at 20/20 and s-bend or slalom progress rises, keep kp 4.5 and kd 0.8. If oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 or oval completions drop, kp 4.5 is too aggressive, so return kp to 4.0 and keep kd 0.8. If s-bend steering_oscillation stays above 0.4 with kd 0.8, kd is not damping enough, so raise kd toward 1.0 before changing kp again.
requested_changes: If oval completions hold at 20/20 and s-bend or slalom progress rises, keep controller.kp at 4.5 and controller.kd at 0.8, then consider a small base_speed step (for example 1.35) only if s-bend completion_time stays near 2.8 s with no line loss.

If oval steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35 or any oval run goes off track, set controller.kp back to 4.0 and keep controller.kd at 0.8, since iteration 3 showed kp 5 with lower damping overshoots.
If s-bend steering_oscillation stays above 0.4 with kd 0.8, raise controller.kd to about 1.0 before changing kp, since iteration 4 showed s-bend oscillation was the highest measured while kd was 0.6.
